description: List the agent sessions behind a site's Index score: one AI provider attempting one benchmark task in a real browser, with status, score, rubric evidence, a summary and the frictions it hit. Defaults to the latest run (pass run_id for another); filter by provider or category. Use it to explain a low score.

category.description: Only sessions for this category id, e.g. "checkout" or "discovery" (the category ids in get_index_report category_scores). Omit for every category.

domain.description: The site to read, e.g. "example.com". A full URL is fine: protocol, path and a leading www. are dropped. Pass this or project_id, not both.

project_id.description: Project UUID, from list_projects. Uses the Index domain linked to that project instead of naming one; fails if the project has no linked domain. Pass this or domain, not both.

provider.description: Only sessions from this provider id, e.g. "claude" or "openai" (the provider ids in get_index_report provider_scores). Omit for every provider.

run_id.description: A specific scoring run UUID, e.g. the run_id request_index_rerun returned or one from an earlier call. Defaults to the newest run that has agent sessions.

name: list_index_sessions

report_url.description: The public Index report page for the site, to link a person to.

run_id.description: The scoring run these sessions belong to. Null when there are none.

frictions.description: Problems the agent hit, as stored.

replay_url.description: Step-by-step replay, published only for claimed domains.

score.description: Score out of 100, null until finished.

status.description: Session status, e.g. running, completed or failed. Poll until none is running.

unscored_reason.description: Present (opted_out) when sessions are withheld because the site opted out.

title: List Index sessions
